build: More than one thing sold from a crop: a column on the yield and price card for each thing a crop sells, with its own unit, price, yield and way of picking; a different thing from each place, two things out of one bed, or one harvest packed two ways. The forecast, the Harvest page, the list to send and “plan to a weekly amount” count each thing in its own unit. A plan with no second thing forecasts as it did.
